company.name: Garrett Williams
company.title: President
company.bio: Garrett leads Nichols Land & Investment Co. and Southeastern Agri-Business Management as President and Registered Forester, overseeing land sales, timberland management and the firm's forestry services across Georgia.

company.name: Carl R. Nichols
company.title: Broker
company.bio: Founder of Nichols Land & Investment Co. and Southeastern Agri-Business Management, Carl has been a Land and Commercial Real Estate Broker and Investor since 1973. With a B.S. in Agriculture from the University of Georgia, Carl built the Nichols name to mean expertise and integrity across Land and Commercial Real Estate Development and Investment. He is a member of the National Association of Realtors and the Athens Area Association of Realtors.

company.name: James E. (Jim) Belger, Jr.
company.title: Vice President, Land Sales
company.bio: As Vice President, Jim specializes in Recreational and Agricultural Land Sales. He graduated from the University of Georgia with a B.A. in Business Administration and has been in Land Sales and Appraisals since 1975. Jim manages land transactions for buyers and sellers, from small family farms to institutional-size investments. He is a member of the National Association of Realtors and the Athens Area Association of Realtors.

company.name: Stephen Davison
company.title: Land Salesperson
company.bio: Stephen is a native of Augusta, Georgia and a graduate of the University of Georgia with a degree in Animal Science. Since 2019 he has built strong communication and leadership skills in animal resources and facility management, and he works diligently to go above and beyond for his clients' real estate needs. Stephen is a member of the Athens Area Association of Realtors, the National Association of Realtors, the Georgia Association of Realtors and the Georgia Cattleman's Association.

company.name: Philip D. Ashford
company.title: Commercial Salesperson
company.bio: Philip joined Nichols Land & Investment Company in 2019 as a licensed real estate salesperson. He graduated from the University of Georgia with a B.S. in Environmental Economics and Management and an M.S. in Geography. Philip has experience in land and commercial property sales, as well as landlord and tenant representation for commercial leases. He is a member of the National Association of Realtors, Georgia Association of Realtors and the Athens Area Association of Realtors.

company.name: Mark A. Day, LEED AP
company.title: Construction and Facilities Manager
company.bio: Mark oversees all building and maintenance for more than 700,000 square feet of industrial, office, retail and medical space. He has coordinated many space developments with architects, engineers and contractors for both new developments and tenant improvements, and manages several office park associations. Before joining Nichols Land in 2015, Mark managed more than $60 million in CM at-risk projects. He earned his B.S. in Construction Management from Georgia Southern University and obtained LEED AP certification in 2009.

company.name: Brandy L. Huff
company.title: Accounting
company.bio: As Accounting Assistant, Brandy supports bookkeeping for the company — accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, and assisting in facility management. She graduated from Athens Tech with a marketing degree and has worked with Nichols Land since 2003.

company.name: Kay W. Oliver
company.title: Administrative Assistant
company.bio: Kay is often our first contact with customers and keeps the office running day to day. Along with administrative work, she aids in the development of annual reports, appraisals and the administration of hunting leases. A graduate of Emmanuel College, Kay served as a departmental secretary and secretary to the dean of the Pharmacy School at the University of Georgia before joining the Nichols Land team in 1995.
